title: Off-Context GRPO: Learning to Reason on Hard Problems using Privileged Information
abstract: arXiv:2607.19313v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in large language models. Yet, typical RLVR approaches fail on difficult problems: when a model cannot generate any correct solutions, it receives \textit{zero} learning signal. Providing privileged guidance during training, such as solution prefixes, can help overcome this learning cliff by steering the model towards {correct solutions with non-zero reward}. {We call these rollouts \textit{off-context}: they are generated from a training prompt that contains privileged guidance, while the target objective is defined by the original prompt without that guidance.} {We introduce} Off-Context GRPO (OC-GRPO), a minimally modified variant of GRPO that uses guided rollouts but applies an importance-corrected objective to steer the update back toward the original unguided objective, avoiding the mismatch that destabilizes uncorrected guided training. translated_title: 离上下文GRPO：利用特权信息学习在困难问题上的推理
translated_abstract: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够提升大型语言模型的推理能力。然而，典型的RLVR方法在困难问题上会失效：当模型无法生成任何正确解时，它只能收到零学习信号。在训练过程中提供特权引导（例如解答前缀），可以通过将模型引向具有非零奖励的正确解，帮助克服这一“学习悬崖”。我们将这类 rollout 称为“离上下文”rollout：它们由包含特权引导的训练提示生成，而目标优化对象则由不含该引导的原始提示定义。我们提出了离上下文GRPO（OC-GRPO），这是GRPO的一个最小修改变体，它使用引导式 rollout，但通过重要性校正的目标函数将更新引回原始的无引导目标，从而避免了未校正引导训练中导致训练不稳定的失配问题。从实证上看，
tldr: 提出OC-GRPO，一种最小修改的GRPO变体，通过在训练中利用特权引导生成“离上下文”rollout，并用重要性校正目标将更新引回原始无引导目标，使模型能够从无法自行解答的困难问题中获得有效的学习信号。
en_tdlr: OC-GRPO is a minimally modified GRPO variant that enables learning on hard problems by training with guided "off-context" rollouts containing privileged information, applying an importance-corrected objective to steer updates back toward the original unguided objective.
